_about: Public-domain James Alexander Haldane (1768-1851, lay evangelist, then pastor of the Tabernacle, Leith Walk, Edinburgh; brother of Robert Haldane) for the Word Hoard: A View of the Social Worship of the First Christians (1805), Man's Responsibility (1842), An Exposition of Galatians (1848), Notes on Hebrews (1860) and The Doctrine of the Atonement (third edition, 1862), raw Internet Archive OCR. IA's catalogue dates the Galatians and Hebrews scans to 2002; their title pages show the 1848 and 1860 originals. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 14 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

jahaldane-social-worship-1805: A View of the Social Worship and Ordinances Observed by the First Christians (Edinburgh: J. Ritchie, 1805)
jahaldane-mans-responsibility-1842: Man's Responsibility; the Nature and Extent of the Atonement; and the Work of the Holy Spirit (Edinburgh: William Whyte, 1842)
jahaldane-galatians-1848: An Exposition of the Epistle to the Galatians (Edinburgh: William Whyte, 1848)
jahaldane-hebrews-1860: Notes Intended for an Exposition of the Epistle to the Hebrews (London: James Nisbet, 1860)
jahaldane-atonement-1862: The Doctrine of the Atonement, with Strictures on Recent Publications, third edition (Edinburgh: William P. Kennedy, 1862)
